errors.text_span: Секторът, съответстващ на "Повше от 20%", е оцветен в лилаво и заема 33.3% от диаграмата
errors.evidence: The purple slice, corresponding to the category "More than 20%" ("Повече от 20%"), represents 9.5% of the chart, not 33.3%. The value 33.3% corresponds to the blue slice ("0-5%"). Also, "Повше" is a typo for "Повече".

errors.evidence: The blue slice, corresponding to the "0-5%" category, represents 33.3% of the chart, not 9.5%. The value 9.5% corresponds to the purple slice ("More than 20%").

errors.text_span: Някой от секторите не е визуално подчертан по-специално от останалите.
errors.evidence: The phrasing "Някой от секторите не е..." is grammatically awkward and translates to "Some of the sectors are not...", which could imply others are. The correct phrasing to convey that no sector is highlighted would be "Никой от секторите не е..." ("None of the sectors is...").
